ios.desc:
100% private, on-device job tracking, automated ghost job detection, and a one-time $4.99 unlock with zero subscriptions.

JobFlo is the all-in-one job application tracker built for job seekers who are serious about getting hired. Organize your entire job search, catch ghost job postings before you waste hours on them, and manage every application from first click to offer letter — synced automatically across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.
Stop tracking your job hunt in a messy spreadsheet. JobFlo gives you a real job search CRM: a visual pipeline board, smart capture tools, resume and salary insights, and the only ghost-job protection system built directly into your job tracker.
GHOST JOB DETECTION & EMPLOYER TRUST SCORES Tired of applying to postings that were never really open? JobFlo scores listings before you apply — flagging vague boilerplate, "internal candidate" reqs, compliance-only postings, and evergreen listings that never close. See a community-sourced Employer Trust Score and response-rate grade for companies before you invest your time. After you apply, JobFlo watches for silence and alerts you when an application goes cold, so you always know where you really stand.
ONE-CLICK JOB CAPTURE Add postings to your pipeline in a single click with the JobFlo browser extension for Safari, Chrome, and Opera, or use the share sheet to save a listing from any app. Smart Paste automatically extracts the job title, company, location, and salary — no manual data entry.
VERIFIED, NOT JUST SAVED JobFlo cross-checks listings directly against Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, SmartRecruiters, and Workable so you know a posting is still live on the source before you apply.
A JOB SEARCH PIPELINE, NOT A TO-DO LIST Track every stage — saved, applied, screening, interview, offer, rejected — on a drag-and-drop pipeline board. Log interview rounds, contacts, deadlines, and notes for every application in one place.
RESUME & OFFER TOOLS
• Resume Gap Score flags weak spots before you submit
• Attach and sync resumes and cover letters per application via iCloud
• Generate tailored cover letters
• Compare offers side by side with a built-in take-home pay and tax calculator covering the US, Canada, UK, Australia, Singapore, and the EU
STAY ON TOP OF EVERYTHING
• Optional Gmail ingestion auto-detects application confirmations and interview invites
• Home screen and lock screen widgets surface hot leads and jobs needing follow-up
• Live Activities keep your next inter
